notes: embed::FS is a read-only fs over (name, bytes) pairs built from include_bytes!. Go's //go:embed directive has no Rust equivalent: rust_stdlib::embed_files! lists files by path (declarative), and the first-party proc macro rust_stdlib_derive::embed! (crates/derive) walks directories and wildcard patterns with Go's rules ('.'/'_' names skipped in directories unless 'all:', no matches is a compile error). FS::open/read_dir/read_file are also the io::fs FS, ReadDirFS and ReadFileFS impls; files are 0444, directories ModeDir|0555, mod times zero, and error values match Go's.
